questions.sql: SELECT name AS service FROM ops.services WHERE tier = 1 LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS deployment_count FROM ops.deployments WHERE service = 'checkout-api' AND deployed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND deployed_at < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 100
SELECT service, version FROM ops.deployments WHERE status = 'rolled_back' LIMIT 100

SELECT engineer AS on_call_engineer FROM ops.oncall_shifts WHERE team = 'payments' AND starts_at <= CAST('2026-10-14 12:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ends_at > CAST('2026-10-14 12:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 100
SELECT service, title FROM ops.alerts WHERE severity = 'critical' AND resolved_at IS NULL LIMIT 100
SELECT version AS most_recent_version FROM ops.deployments WHERE service = 'orders-api' ORDER BY deployed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH october AS (SELECT service, availability FROM ops.error_budget WHERE month = CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) SELECT service FROM october WHERE availability = (SELECT MIN(availability) FROM october) LIMIT 100

SELECT s.name AS service, COUNT(a.id) AS alert_count FROM ops.services AS s LEFT JOIN ops.alerts AS a ON a.service = s.name AND a.fired_at >= CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND a.fired_at < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY s.name LIMIT 100
SELECT service FROM ops.error_budget WHERE month = CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND budget_remaining <= 0 LIMIT 100

WITH deployment_counts AS (SELECT deployed_by AS engineer, COUNT(*) AS deployment_count FROM ops.deployments WHERE deployed_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY deployed_by), ranked AS (SELECT engineer, deployment_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deployment_count DESC) AS position FROM deployment_counts) SELECT engineer, deployment_count FROM ranked WHERE position = 1 LIMIT 100
SELECT team FROM ops.services WHERE name = 'search-indexer' LIMIT 100
SELECT version FROM ops.deployments WHERE service = 'payments-gateway' AND deployed_at > CAST('2026-10-20 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ORDER BY deployed_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS warning_alerts_resolved_within_one_hour FROM ops.alerts WHERE severity = 'warning' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= fired_at AND resolved_at <= fired_at + INTERVAL '1 HOUR' LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS service FROM ops.services AS s JOIN ops.deployments AS d ON d.service = s.name JOIN ops.alerts AS a ON a.service = s.name WHERE d.status = 'failed' AND a.severity = 'critical' AND CAST((d.deployed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = CAST((a.fired_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) LIMIT 100
SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS service_count FROM ops.services GROUP BY team LIMIT 100
